title: General Conditions of the Marlowe & Finch Alterations Price List
content:
These general conditions govern how charges are put on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket. Clauses marked as no longer in force are kept for the record together with the limits of their retirement.

**1. Operations and lined surcharges.**
> Each operation on the ticket is charged at the class's operation prices; when the garment is lined, a lined surcharge charge adds the class's lined-garment surcharge percentage of that operation's price, rounded half up to the cent.

For a lined surcharge on an operation added to the ticket after its drop-off date, this clause is **no longer in force**; that surcharge is superseded by the current added-work lining terms. Each operation is still charged at the class's operation prices, and every other lined surcharge — such as one on an operation booked at drop-off — remains under this clause.

**2. Rush fee.**
> A rush fee charge on the ticket is the class's rush fee percentage of the ticket's operation charges (every operation charge and every lined surcharge charge on the ticket), rounded half up to the cent, once per ticket.

For a rush fee that customer care books on a ticket, this clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current rush fee terms. Such a fee is still booked once per ticket and rounded half up to the cent, and every other charge on the ticket remains under these conditions.

**3. Extra fittings.**
> Each fitting beyond the class's included fittings is charged the class's extra fitting fee.

For an extra fitting fee booked when the customer books an extra fitting through customer care, this clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current extra fitting fee terms. A fitting within the class's included fittings is still never charged, and every other charge remains under these conditions.

**4. Work beyond the quote.** Operations beyond the quote are added only after the customer approves them. This sentence remains in force.

**5. Overrun of the quote.**
> When the final operation charges exceed the quoted total by more than the class's quote-overrun tolerance percentage without such approval, the excess is waived as a quote overrun.

For a quote overrun waiver that customer care books, this clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current quote overrun terms. Operations beyond the quote are still added only after the customer approves them, and every other charge remains under these conditions.

**6. Pressing.** Final pressing is included and never charged.

**7. Sales tax.** Sales tax on alteration charges follows the store's state rules: it is included in the listed prices and never added on top.

## Hypothetical illustration of clause 1 where it stands

On a lined garment in a class with a 20 percent lined-garment surcharge, an operation booked at drop-off at 24.00 USD carries a lined surcharge of 4.80 USD (20 percent of 24.00 USD). At a 25 percent surcharge, a 22.50 USD operation gives 5.625 USD, which rounds half up to 5.63 USD.

superseded_clauses: Each operation on the ticket is charged at the class's operation_prices; when the garment is lined, a lined_surcharge row adds lined_garment_surcharge_pct of that operation's price, rounded half up to the cent.
A rush fee row charges rush_fee_pct of alteration_msr_operation_charges, rounded half up to the cent, once per ticket.
Each fitting beyond fittings_included is charged extra_fitting_fee_usd.
when the final operation charges exceed the quoted_total by more than quote_overrun_tolerance_pct without such approval, the excess is waived with waiver_reason quote_overrun.
